## Outcome

Describe the user/engineering outcome and non-goals.

## Change

Summarize the smallest reviewable set of changes and affected boundaries.

## Verification

List exact checks run and results. Include deterministic replay, race/failure, accessibility, or benchmark evidence when relevant.

## Impact checklist

- [ ] Contracts and compatibility considered
- [ ] Determinism/reproducibility considered
- [ ] Security/privacy/abuse and secret handling considered
- [ ] Data source, license, and attribution considered
- [ ] Performance/resources/cost considered; claims are measured or labeled hypotheses
- [ ] Accessibility and reduced motion considered
- [ ] Observability, migration, rollback, and recovery considered
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs updated where architecture/behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, large/generated data, caches, or machine-specific paths added

## Risks and follow-up

State residual risk, rollout/rollback, and deliberately deferred work.
